items.heading: Palauan Fruit Bat Soup
details: Key ingredients: coconut milk, ginger, vegetables
Simmer coconut milk with ginger and aromatics.
Add local root vegetables and simmer until tender.
Season the rich broth to taste.
Serve hot as a traditional celebratory dish.

items.heading: Tapioca Coconut Pudding
details: Key ingredients: tapioca, coconut milk, sugar
Simmer tapioca pearls in water until translucent.
Stir in coconut milk and sugar.
Cook gently until thickened to a pudding consistency.
Chill or serve warm as a sweet treat.
